tasks.checkResult:
Complete UI/UX redesign of MeetRoom from an outdated Angular/Bootstrap "Hotel Empire" theme to a modern, accessible, cohesive static site.

**What was built:**

- `css/main.css` — Full design system (600+ lines): CSS custom properties for all tokens (colors, typography, spacing, shadows, radii, transitions), plus every UI component styled from scratch
- `index.html` — Home page: sticky frosted-glass nav with dropdown, gradient hero with animated badge and stats, live room availability preview card, stats strip, 6-feature grid, gradient CTA banner, 4-col footer
- `rooms.html` — Rooms listing: search/filter bar (by name/capacity/equipment), auto-updating results count, skeleton shimmer loaders, room cards with image area + capacity badge + equipment tags + inline date picker + reserve button, success/error alerts, empty/error states
- `reservations.html` — Reservations listing: cards with icon, equipment tags, formatted date pill, empty/error states, retry button, "New booking" CTA in page header
- `js/app.js` — Mobile hamburger nav, API fetch for rooms+reservations, live client-side filtering, reservation POST with loading state, auto-dismiss alert banners

**Pain points fixed:**
- Outdated Hotel Empire theme replaced with clean modern design tokens
- Low-contrast `#ed5565` red replaced with WCAG AA compliant `#2563eb` blue primary
- Inconsistent fonts replaced with single Inter typeface + systematic scale
- Absolute-positioned date picker replaced with proper flexbox layout
- Bare single-line footer replaced with structured 4-col footer
- No empty/error states — now designed with illustrations and CTAs
- No loading feedback — now skeleton shimmer loaders on all data pages
- Angular framework (not openable as static) — pure HTML/CSS/JS works by opening index.html
- No accessibility — full ARIA roles, labels, live regions, keyboard nav
